advice: Abstain from proposing a new scratch lifetime experiment. The supplied distinct mechanism is the sixteen-call panel32 path, already measured with mixed paired results and not promoted. The evidence does not establish a different legal scratch allocation or initialization change with defined packing layout, consumers, and traversal. This abstention makes no performance claim.
risks: A new scratch design would need coordinated changes to allocation size, packing, consumer strides, and traversal. The supplied evidence does not specify another design well enough to check bounds and correctness without inventing changes. The prior panel measurements do not isolate scratch effects or establish causality.
